visualCharacteristics.purpose: contact / how-to-apply panel: columns of heading, icon-led help lines, phone numbers and links

contentPattern.structure: one row; one cell per column. Each cell: heading, then icon-led lines (icon + subheading), text, phone link and arrow links. A cell holding only a /fragments/ link is replaced by the fragment. with-select: a list of links in a cell becomes a dropdown (a list item without a link is the placeholder); a button straight after the list opens the chosen link

usage: Contact, call-us, apply-now and still-have-questions panels with 2-3 columns
reuseGuidance: Use for contact/help panels. Not for icon feature rows (columns-icon-features) or link strips (columns-icon-strip).
